reason: The MCP connector moves onto mdbase-next as an ordinary SDK thin client. The new modules are the transport (next-gateway), the only place legacy tool schemas meet the next replica API (next-mapping, golden-tested per input), the attested client Noise key custody (next-keys), and the shared GatewayOperationError (errors, moved out of connect.ts). The control plane gains one route module for the one-time client key attach on existing grants. The legacy authority path stays unchanged until it is removed.
